title: Batteries page: status rows, filters and empty state
goal: The batteries page uses bricks status row or list row, the filters pattern and empty state
acceptance: Battery rows with the status rail use status row or list row with a tone per state; sections keep their headings
Filters use the filters pattern; an empty list shows the empty state
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take FPVBuddy's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one 142-line page and one filter bar. Not a measurement.
